'''Aja Novar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal who was a henchman of a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Novar carried a large [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] in battle, and her lieutenants were known as "Face Butchers."<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aja Novar appears as one of the possible Henchmen Bounties in the Bounty Contract Week, a recurring World Event added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. Novar can be summoned by using Rendezvous Beacon C-73, which appears on the planets [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and [[Voss]]. The player has the option to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her or capture her alive with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], so as a result, this article refrains from assuming which crime lord she worked for, where she was encountered, and her fate.<ref name="TOR" />
